title: Blake Ruwali | AI for the trades. Home+ Air & Heat and Techeo
meta_desc: Blake Ruwali builds AI for the trades. Blake runs Home+ Air & Heat, an HVAC company on Long Island, and founded Techeo, AI and marketing for HVAC and plumbing shops.
og_desc: Nepal → Long Island → HVAC + AI. Blake runs Home+ Air & Heat and builds the AI behind it through Techeo.
hero_lede: I'm Blake Ruwali. I run Home+ Air & Heat, a real HVAC company on Long Island, and I build the AI behind it. Now I'm showing the trades how.
hero_alt: Blake Ruwali outdoors in a navy blazer
stat3: technology consulting revenue at Takeo.AI, 2019 to 2025
story_h2: From winters without heat to building AI for the people who install it.
step1_text: A village called Golang in the Himalayan foothills, then Kathmandu. Winters without heat meant getting sick every year.
step2_text: President and CEO. Technology bootcamps, career services and consulting. I still own it.
step3_text: The system in my new house kept breaking down. So I started an HVAC company and ran it the way I build software: measure everything, and put AI in every step.
step4_text: The AI we run at Home+, built for other HVAC and plumbing shops.
story_photo_alt: Blake Ruwali in a grey suit and blue shirt
edu: MS in Information Technology, University of the Cumberlands · BBA in Global Information Systems, Troy University
now_h2: One real company. One company that brings its AI to yours.
hp_text: A real HVAC company on Long Island and in New York City. Real trucks, real techs, real customers. Every AI tool gets tested here first.
hp_alt: Blake Ruwali working at a desk in the Home+ office
te_text: AI and marketing for HVAC and plumbing companies: answering calls, following up, building estimates and getting found in AI search. The same systems we run at Home+.
te_alt: Blake Ruwali in a suit with a laptop at a café
flow1_text: An AI phone agent picks up when the office can't, asks the right questions and books the slot.
flow2_text: An iPad LiDAR scan turns the house into a 3D model and a floor plan with real room sizes.
flow3_text: A Manual J load calculation shows how hard the house pulls in winter and summer.
flow4_text: Photos and notes become a proposal the customer signs on their phone. A person checks every one.
content_h2: I post what actually happens. Every day.
content_p: Real jobs, real screens, and the AI tools I'm testing in a real HVAC company. No hype.

guide_p: Your next job calls at 7pm. Nobody answers, so they call the next company. Get the one-page checklist I use to set up AI to answer, ask the right questions and book the slot, with a person checking.
guide_how: DM me "AI" on Instagram and I'll send it over.
guide_note: The audit is a free call with Techeo. We look at how your phones, follow-up and estimates run today.
foot_also_html: Also founded Com+ Mechanical and Long Island HVAC Repair. Owner of Takeo.AI.
